text:
samira: Thanks for the all-hands discussion today. dropping the RCA link + a short owners list for follow-ups so we can close the loop.

samira: RCA: https://internal.redwood.ai/rca/INC-2026-233 (root cause: routing preference regression + spillover under load). full timeline and mitigation steps in doc.

ben: are the mitigations live everywhere or limited to a few regions?
samira: mitigation (rate caps + pref tweak) is live in prod regions A and B; regions C/D will follow after validation.
kai: i'll take the region C rollout and post-deploy checks. ETA: 48h.
lucy: i'll own region D rollout; pairing with infra for the window.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: pref-tweak-canary-A -> success; pref-tweak-canary-B -> success.

omar: i'll open a small PR to add a config validator to prevent conflicting route prefs. aim to land in 3 days.

rebecca: comms: what's the status page wording? we'd like something that doesn't promise full resolution until rollouts finish.
samira: suggested blurb: "Mitigation applied in affected regions; validation ongoing; full rollouts scheduled." keep it short.

ben: accepted: monitoring dashboard alert tuning -> ben (due 2026-04-05).
kai: accepted: region C rollout + verifications (latency, errors) -> kai (due 2026-04-04).
lucy: accepted: region D rollout scheduling -> lucy (due 2026-04-04).
omar: accepted: config validator PR -> omar (due 2026-04-06).
rebecca: accepted: status blurb draft + publish after signoff -> rebecca (pending).

samira: ACTIONS (also mirrored to tracker):
- ben: tune monitoring alerts and add a dashboard widget for spill signals
- kai: rollout to region C + post-deploy checks (latency, error-rate, cache-hit)
- lucy: schedule region D window and coordinate with infra
- omar: config validator PR to block conflicting prefs
- rebecca: publish status blurb after confirmation

samira: please react when you've started your item. ping here with any blockers or permission needs.

ben: tiny blocker  need access to the aggregated spill logs. @ops can you share?
ops-bot: access-request: spill-logs-dashboard -> submitted for ben. expect approval in 10m.

kai: starting verifications now, will post a short verification note in the tracker at 24h.
lucy: scheduling invites now; will include oncall.
